consent.heading: Recipient data processing consent
consent.purpose: I consent to the processing of recipient data for the purpose of delivering the voucher. Data will be retained for 365 days and may be erased on request in accordance with the GDPR.
consent.checkbox_label: I have read and agree to the information above.
consent.checkbox_aria: I consent to the processing of recipient data
consent.withdraw_explainer: You can withdraw consent at any time. Withdrawal is as easy as giving consent (GDPR art. 7(3)).
consent.error_audit_failed: We could not record your consent. Please try again in a moment.
consent.privacy_link_aria: Open privacy policy in a new tab

pause.heading: Not ready to decide yet?
pause.description_default: If you need more time to read the information, you can pause your decision.
pause.description_considering: You are considering. You can pause for 14 days or cancel and return to consent.
pause.description_paused: Decision paused. We will check back in 14 days; you can also resume or withdraw now.
pause.description_timeout: The pause window has expired. You can resume the flow or withdraw consent.
pause.description_withdrawn: Consent withdrawn. Recipient data has been marked for erasure (GDPR art. 17).
